github.boundary: Repository, pull-request, Actions, and security evidence. Exact branch, commit, and approval state remain mandatory for writes.

context7.boundary: Current public library documentation only; never runtime or release proof.

playwright.boundary: Browser-visible verification and recovery-path evidence only. Source inspection alone is never proof that a UI or runtime flow works.

supabase.boundary: Control Room project-scoped read-only inspection by default. DDL remains migration-first and separately approved.

cloudflare.boundary: Account-scoped Cloudflare API Code Mode. Read by default; writes, deployments, DNS, billing, credentials, and destructive actions require separate founder approval and provider evidence.

cloudflare-stack.boundary: Supplemental Cloudflare Stack MCP endpoint. Treat it as provider context only; the in-app Control Room hub permits read-shaped tools and denies generic execute or mutation-capable tools until provider-level read-only authority is proven.

cloudflare-docs.boundary: Current public Cloudflare documentation only; documentation is not runtime or deployment proof.

cloudflare-bindings.boundary: Inspect Workers bindings and project wiring. Binding mutations and production environment changes remain separately approved.

cloudflare-builds.boundary: Read build evidence only. Deployment, rollback, and production promotion remain separate approval gates.

cloudflare-observability.boundary: Read minimized operational telemetry only; do not copy raw sensitive payloads or treat logs as authorization.

figma.boundary: Canonical design creation, inspection, and implementation handoff only. Figma cannot authorize code changes, migrations, integration, deployment, spending, or external action.
